files.name: CHANGELOG.md
files.body:
`api: 2` unchanged; capabilities `invoice_documents: 2`, `quotes: 4`,
`quote_documents: 1`, `invoice_layout: 2`; migration adds the reservation
columns and `documents_json` to `ts_inv_invoices` (nothing dropped). Not
additive for issuing: the server renders no document any more (PLAN-FAKTURA
§11.4, §11.5, §12; PLAN-SPESEN §1 «one renderer»; decisions E1–E6 of
2026-10-29). A Mac of `invoice_documents: 1` must not issue against this
server; the Mac app checks the capability.

- **One renderer: the app's PDF closes the issue** (2026-10-29).
  `POST /invoices/{key}/issue` reserves number, `issued_on`, `due_on` and
  the next chain link (`seq`, `prev_hash`) and answers the frozen content
  plus the footer sentence `chain_line`; the invoice is `issuing`. The app
  renders the PDF with number and chain line and sends it raw to
  `PUT /invoices/{key}/document` (`application/pdf`, ≤ 20 MB, must start
  with `%PDF-` and contain number and chain line). The server files it under
  `Buchhaltung/<year>/Rechnungen/<date>_<number>_<customer>.pdf`, appends the
  ledger entry with the reserved link – its payload is the frozen invoice
  plus `document { kind, name, size, sha256 }`, so one hash covers content
  and PDF – and sets `issued`. `POST /invoices/{key}/issue/cancel` or
  15 minutes without a document release number and link again (only while
  the number is the counter's last: `number_not_last`); the record is a
  draft again, nothing is in the ledger, numbers stay gapless. While an issue
  is pending the team's ledger is closed: every other ledger write,
  `next-number` and writes to that record answer `409 issue_pending`.
  `reverse` reserves the same way for the reversal or credit note; the
  original changes only at the close.
- **Nothing is rendered on the server** (2026-10-29). `GET
  /invoices/{key}/preview` and `POST /invoices/{key}/render` answer `410`
  `{ error: "gone", code: "gone" }`. `InvoicePdf`, `InvoicePage`,
  `InvoiceDocument`, `EInvoiceXml`, the job `DocumentRetry` and the libraries
  `tecnickcom/tcpdf`, `setasign/fpdi`, `sprain/swiss-qr-bill` and
  `horstoeko/zugferd` are removed. `document_state`, `document_error` and
  `document_tries` leave `issue`, `fixed` and the record; `fixed` and the
  record carry `documents[]` instead (older invoices read their stored
  files there). An invoice issued by ≤ 0.31.0 whose render had failed takes
  the app's PDF once with a `document` ledger entry as in 0.19.0.
- **E-invoice XML from the app** (2026-10-29). The app embeds ZUGFeRD in the
  PDF/A-3 itself and sends the XRechnung file after the close to
  `PUT /invoices/{key}/document?kind=xml` (raw, ≤ 20 MB, well-formed CII or
  UBL parsed without network or DTD, must name the number); the server
  files it next to the PDF with a ledger `document` entry (`kind:
  xrechnung`). Tax case and QRR reference are still frozen by the server and
  handed to the app (`e_invoice: 1` stays).
- **Chain verification with files** (2026-10-29). `GET
  /invoices/chain/verify?files=true` re-hashes every filed PDF and XML
  named in a payload; a difference is `first_break` with `field:
  "document"`. A PDF in hand is checked by its number, its chain line
  (`seq`, `prev_hash`) and its SHA-256 against the entry's payload.
- **Quotes with texts, attachments and a number on issue** (2026-10-29).
  The `quote` record takes `texts { greeting, intro, closing, footer }`
  (each ≤ 4000 characters) and `attachments` (≤ 2000, one per line).
  `POST /quotes/{key}/issue { date?, valid_until?, hours?, amount? }` by
  Team Admins and the quote's Leads sets `number` from the team's quote
  counter and pattern `settings.quote_number` (default `OF-{year}-{no}`,
  per year), `date`, `status: quoted`, and freezes the offered part –
  budgets, texts, attachments, customer, sums – as the server field
  `issued`; afterwards `number` and `issued` do not change
  (`quote_issued_frozen`), everything else stays writable. Only a draft is
  issued (`quote_not_draft`); nothing goes into the ledger. A `draft` may be
  unnamed (the app makes the draft first and names it later); the issue and
  every other status need a name (`422 quote_name_required`, `field: name`).
- **Three quote documents** (2026-10-29). `PUT /quotes/{key}/document`
  stays for the TimeSister PDF and now needs an issued quote;
  `POST /quotes/{key}/documents?kind=sent|signed` (raw PDF, ≤ 20 MB) files
  what went to the customer and the signed copy as
  `<date>_OF-<n>_<customer>_gesendet.pdf` / `_unterschrieben.pdf` (a second
  of a kind is added with `_2`, never overwritten; at most 10 per quote);
  `GET /quotes/{key}/documents` lists them, `GET /quotes/{key}/document?kind=&name=`
  serves one. The record carries `documents[]` (server field).
- **Invoice layout appendices** (2026-10-29). `layout.appendix` also takes
  `aps`, `companies` and `rates` (PLAN-BACKLOG 28); the client computes
  every table it lists (`levels`, `budget`, `tags`, `aps`, `companies`,
  `rates`), the server checks the form (lists of at most 500 objects),
  stores and freezes the layout and no longer computes `tags` itself.
- **Error codes** (2026-10-29). New: `issue_pending`, `not_issuing`,
  `document_missing`, `number_not_last`, `document_mismatch`,
  `document_exists`, `quote_lead_only`, `quote_not_draft`,
  `quote_not_issued`, `quote_issued_frozen`, `quote_number_taken`,
  `quote_documents_max`; `gone` also names `preview` and `render`.
- **Rate limits** (2026-10-29). `issue`, `issue/cancel`, `reverse`,
  `quotes/{key}/issue` 60 per minute; the uploads `PUT
  /invoices/{key}/document`, `PUT /quotes/{key}/document`, `POST
  /quotes/{key}/documents` 30; the reads 120; `chain/verify` 30. The job
  `IssueExpiry` (every 5 minutes) releases expired reservations.
- **From the implementation** (2026-10-29). Migration 1023 adds `issue_seq`,
  `issue_prev_hash`, `issue_expires_at` and `documents_json` to
  `ts_inv_invoices`. The ledger lock sits in `LedgerAppender::append`, so the
  XML upload and `POST …/external` wait for a pending issue too; the close of
  a reversal still appends the original's `cancelled` entry after the
  `reversal` entry (as 0.18.0); a reservation whose number is no longer the
  counter's last is kept by the timeout as by the cancel (`number_not_last`).
  `composer.json` has no runtime requirement any more; `README` and
  `.nextcloudignore` follow. New classes `IssueLock`, `IssueRelease`,
  `QuoteIssueService`, job `IssueExpiry`; `Json::object()`.
